customManagers.description: The deployment contract carries the runtime base image as a literal that tests/unit/test_deployment/test_contract.py requires to match the Dockerfile's runtime FROM. No built-in manager reads it, so without this a base-image digest PR changes only the Dockerfile and fails that test.

packageRules.description: Held below 2.0 until after GA: their next majors change behaviour the engine relies on. Updates inside the held line, security fixes included, still arrive. The reason for each hold sits beside its dependency in pyproject.toml.
Held on 0.6 until after GA: later 0.x minors change the SCIM models' API. Patch updates on 0.6 still arrive.
